dedupe_keys.name: ferc data portal federal regulator s datasets on hydropower licences gas and oil pipelines electric utilities and nepa schedules

description: The open data portal of the US energy regulator, with a data catalogue and a public API. Contents: the catalogue's filters list 12 data assets across four industries (natural gas, oil, electric, hydropower), among them active hydropower projects, annual charges, company registration (the FERC Company Identifier listing), Form 549D quarterly transaction reports, Form 556 qualifying facility certifications, Form 1 annual reports of major electric utilities, Form 6 annual reports of oil pipeline companies, Form 552 natural gas transactions, the market-based rate database, notices of intent to construct qualifying conduit hydropower facilities and the NEPA schedule for pending infrastructure projects. Producer: FERC, with each dataset naming a program office. Coverage: United States. Format and access: dataset pages offer CSV and XLSX downloads and an API (api.data.ferc.gov, version 1) that needs a free key from a sign-up form; row counts did not render in the cloud. Licence: no licence beyond an open data disclaimer that the data is provided as is and may contain errors, and that modifications must be described. Caveats: datasets are subsets of official filings without footnote data. Simulation uses: regulated asset, operator and project pipeline inputs for power, gas and hydropower system capacity and permitting models. Related records: none identified.
